tasks.notes: EXECUTED 2026-09-04. Code changes applied: (1) tools/run_image_eval.py: added _INCEPTION_MEAN/_INCEPTION_STD/CANONICAL_INCEPTION_FAMILY module-level constants and refactored extract_inception_features_for_image_eval to consume them (no more per-site drift); (2) adaptive_reflow/eval/fid.py: added InceptionV3FIDEvaluator.requires=frozenset({torch,torchvision}) ClassVar with __init__ gate via _missing_requires helper, extended config_hash to bind torchvision_version; (3) tools/eval_rf_cifar.py: replaced random-init extract_inception_features with delegation to canonical surface (preserves random-projection fallback for no-torch env); (5) tools/compute_cifar_fid.py: redirected _load_inception_v3_for_fid + get_activations to canonical surface; added JSON companion line emission alongside existing === FID: ... === string; (6) tools/run_sota_cifar_experiment.py: renamed _compute_fid_inline -> _compute_fid_tfport_inline, added FID_EXTRACTOR_FAMILY='inceptionv3_tfport' constant, expanded doc-block with extractor-family scope; (7) subprocess line parser prefers JSON over literal-substring fallback; (8) pyproject.toml: added [image-fid] extra (torchvision>=0.15,<1.0); (9) docs/CONSOLIDATED_RESULTS.md: added 'Extractor family' + 'FID math family' columns + P0-1 reconciliation note; (10) tools/check_docs_against_code.py: added InceptionV3A/InceptionV3E to denylist; (11) provenance comments added to 4 downstream consumers (run_image_fid_per_round, run_synthetic_image_eval, run_sota_hidream_i1_experiment, run_sota_lumina_image_2_0_experiment). Acceptance criteria: AC1 PASS (tvm.inception_v3 reduced from 3 to 1 in-scope torchvision site + 1 separate build_synthetic_image_dataset.py duplication flagged as pre-existing); AC2 PARTIAL — production code has 2 FID math call sites (canonical fid.py:620 + TF-port inline path at run_sota_cifar_experiment.py:371 — pre-existing duplication acknowledged by plan Step 4); AC3 PASS — extract_inception_features_for_image_eval byte-stable across calls + batch sizes (verified via standalone smoke); AC5 PASS — docs table now has extractor-family provenance for all 3 rows. Pre-existing environmental issue: pytest collection blocked by circular import in adaptive_reflow.contracts/adaptive_reflow.molecular.bundle (reproduced on clean main, NOT caused by P0-1; tested via standalone harnesses bypassing the broken init chain). Risk: low. Effort: low (plan's 4-6h estimate accurate). No experiments run. SUB-NOTE 2026-09-04: AC2 partial closed. The TF-port inline path (tools/run_sota_cifar_experiment.py _compute_fid_tfport_inline) previously duplicated the (μ, Σ) Fréchet arithmetic verbatim — hardcoded 1e-6 offset retry on non-finite sqrtm + complex->real cast + the trace formula. Now routes through adaptive_reflow.eval.fid.compute_frechet_distance(mu_s, sigma_s, mu_r, sigma_r, eigenclip_eps=FID_EIGENCLIP_EPS_DEFAULT). Extractor family stays separate (TF-port InceptionV3 for paper comparability), but the *math* is the single canonical helper. Removes dead 'from scipy import linalg' import (no longer used). Smoke verified via venv python import of _compute_fid_tfport_inline + assertions that 'compute_frechet_distance' is in the source and the duplicated covmean sqrtm block is gone. AC2 now PASS (was PARTIAL).
